featured_reviews.name: Dr. Ashish Suresh Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nayan Optics - Kurla, Mumbai

I recently visited Nayan Optics in Kurla, Mumbai, and had an excellent experience. Here's a breakdown of what made my visit so worthwhile:
1. Wide Range of Products
Nayan Optics has an impressive selection of eyewear, including trendy frames, sunglasses, and specialized lenses. They cater to all age groups and preferences, from fashionable frames to functional ones for everyday use. They also offer high-quality lenses like anti-glare, blue-light filtering, and polarized options, which makes it easy to find something suited to both style and eye care needs.
2. Knowledgeable Staff and Personalized Service
The staff at Nayan Optics is highly knowledgeable about their products and the latest eyewear trends. They took the time to understand my specific needs, explain lens options, and suggest frame styles that would complement my face shape. Their recommendations were spot-on, and I felt the focus was on getting the best fit for me rather than simply making a sale.
3. Advanced Eye Testing Facility
One of the best parts of my experience was the advanced eye testing available at the store. The setup is modern, with the latest equipment for accurate and comprehensive eye exams. The optometrists were thorough, explaining each step of the process and ensuring my prescription was exactly right.
4. Competitive Pricing and Deals
Compared to other optical stores, Nayan Optics offers very reasonable pricing, especially considering the quality of products and service. They have various offers and discounts on branded frames and lenses, making it easy to find something that fits within budget without compromising on quality.
5. Quick Turnaround Time
Nayan Optics also impressed me with how quickly they delivered my glasses. Even with custom lenses, they managed to prepare them within a few days, which is great for anyone who needs their eyewear quickly.
6. Clean and Inviting Store Ambience
The store itself is well-organized and welcoming, with a layout that makes browsing easy. They maintain cleanliness and hygiene, which adds to the overall comfort while shopping.
Final Verdict:
Nayan Optics is a fantastic choice for anyone looking for high-quality eyewear in Mumbai. The store combines a great range of products with excellent customer service and competitive prices. I highly recommend Nayan Optics for anyone in the area needing new glasses, lenses, or simply a trusted place for regular eye check-ups.
Good Wishes Team Nayan Optics

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic and disappointing service quality !!!

I had purchased Ray Ban Mega Wayfarer, numbered glasses worth 34,490 Rupees from Gangar, Phoenix Mall, LBS Road, also to mention this was not my only buy from this store.

Within 6 months of purchase, for some reason One of the temple hinge had damaged and  I needed them to be replaced.

When approached Mr Amit Bole & Mr.Siraj Qureshi from Gangar , Phoenix Mall, LBS Road for replacement of temples or hinges , they tried repairing the hinge but not as expected.

When requested for better solution , they suggested replacement of temple if available at warehouse, if not then they advised to buy a complete new frame…..which costs 14k.

I was prepared to pay for temples or hinges but buying a new frame did not sound feasible to me.
Hence I requested them to procure temples or hinges even if it had to be imported and time consuming.

There after I had been following it up with Mr Amit / Mr Siraj through calls and via visiting the store but the only answer I had been getting was “Temples are not in stock and we are constantly following it up Ray-Ban warehouse in this regard”… this was a blatant lie!!

Fo almost one year I had been following it up with Mr Amit/ Mr Siraj but with no success.

Tired of their non-cooperation I approached Gangar, Chembur branch and they were more than willing to assist on the issue even though we had not purchased it from them.

They asked an advance amount to initiate importing temples from Italy and within 40 days I received new temples….but Gangar Phoenix still had the same answer.

Conclusion :
Sales executive in this store are good when you are buying a new product but after sales service is absolutely crap. They only have sugar coated talks to give.

I did not see the willingness to assist in procuring temples at all, they only stressed on buying a new frame all the while.

Whereas when I approached Gangar, Chembur branch ,they were very welcoming and ready to assist and issue was resolved.
